people.name: Belinda R. Beck
people.title: Professor of Clinical Exercise Physiology
people.affiliation: Griffith University / The Bone Clinic, Brisbane, Australia
people.known_for: Principal investigator of the LIFTMOR (2018) and LIFTMOR-M (2020) trials — demonstrated that supervised high-intensity resistance and impact training safely increases BMD in postmenopausal women with osteopenia/osteoporosis

people.name: Keith Baar
people.title: Professor of Molecular Exercise Physiology
people.known_for: Collagen/tendon/ligament adaptation research — pioneered 15 g hydrolyzed collagen + 50 mg vitamin C, 30-60 min before loading protocol for connective tissue remodeling

people.name: Cees Vermeer
people.title: Vitamin K researcher (retired)
people.known_for: Long-term MK-7 supplementation research — 3-year Knapen 2013 RCT showing 180 µg/day MK-7 slowed age-related bone loss and improved BMD at lumbar spine + femoral neck in postmenopausal women

people.name: Leon J. Schurgers
people.title: Professor of Biochemistry of Vascular Calcification
people.known_for: Matrix Gla-Protein (MGP) + osteocalcin carboxylation research — mechanistic basis of vitamin K2's dual role routing calcium to bone and away from arteries

people.name: Walter C. Willett
people.title: Professor of Epidemiology and Nutrition
people.affiliation: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health
people.known_for: Nurses' Health Study — findings that high dairy/calcium intake does NOT reduce hip fracture risk and may be associated with increased fractures; vocal critic of 3-glasses-of-milk-a-day guidance

people.name: Roy D. Altman
people.title: Professor Emeritus of Medicine, Rheumatology
people.known_for: Principal investigator of the Crolla/Lugo UC-II vs glucosamine-chondroitin 2016 trial — showed 40 mg/day undenatured type-II collagen improved knee OA WOMAC scores more than 1500 mg glucosamine + 1200 mg chondroitin

people.name: Daniel O. Clegg
people.title: Rheumatologist, Professor of Medicine
people.affiliation: University of Utah School of Medicine
people.known_for: Lead author of the NIH-funded GAIT trial (Glucosamine/chondroitin Arthritis Intervention Trial, NEJM 2006) — glucosamine+chondroitin not superior to placebo overall, but signal of benefit in moderate-to-severe knee OA subgroup

people.name: Heike A. Bischoff-Ferrari
people.title: Professor of Geriatrics and Aging Research
people.affiliation: University of Zurich / University Hospital Zurich
people.known_for: Large pooled analyses on vitamin D and fracture prevention — 2012 NEJM meta-analysis showing ≥800 IU/day vitamin D reduced hip fracture risk by ~30% in people ≥65 y

people.name: Peter Attia
people.title: Physician, longevity author
people.known_for: 'Outlive' — frames bone density and muscle mass as the twin pillars of preventing 'marginal decade' decline; advocates DEXA screening + heavy resistance training

people.name: Andrew Huberman
people.title: Associate Professor of Neurobiology
people.known_for: Huberman Lab episodes on bone and joint health — popularized Beck's LIFTMOR protocols for general audiences

molecules.name: Calcium Citrate
molecules.label_th: แคลเซียมซิเตรต
molecules.role: Organic calcium salt — ~24% elemental calcium; absorbed well independent of gastric acid (better for elderly, PPI users); less risk of kidney stones than carbonate

molecules.name: Calcium Carbonate
molecules.label_th: แคลเซียมคาร์บอเนต
molecules.role: ~40% elemental calcium — cheapest form, requires acidic stomach to dissolve (take with food); dominant form in most OTC Thai calcium supplements

molecules.name: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)
molecules.role: Drives intestinal calcium absorption (↑TRPV6, calbindin-D9k) and maintains serum calcium; deficiency (<20 ng/mL 25-OH-D) causes osteomalacia / secondary hyperparathyroidism accelerating bone loss

molecules.name: Vitamin K2 MK-7 (Menaquinone-7)
molecules.label_th: วิตามินเค 2 เอ็มเค 7
molecules.role: Long half-life (~72 h) vitamin K2 — carboxylates osteocalcin (binds Ca to bone matrix) + MGP (inhibits arterial calcification); 180 µg/day is the studied effective dose (Knapen 3-y RCT)

molecules.name: Vitamin K2 MK-4 (Menaquinone-4)
molecules.label_th: วิตามินเค 2 เอ็มเค 4
molecules.role: Short half-life (~1 h) vitamin K2 — Japanese trials used pharmacologic 45 mg/day to reduce fracture risk; interconverts with MK-7 tissue pools

molecules.name: Magnesium Glycinate (bisglycinate)
molecules.label_th: แมกนีเซียมไกลซิเนต
molecules.role: Mg cofactor for ~300 enzymes including those activating vitamin D (25-hydroxylase, 1α-hydroxylase); ~60% of body Mg is stored in bone; chelate form has high bioavailability and low laxative effect

molecules.name: Osteocalcin (BGLAP)
molecules.label_th: ออสเตโอแคลซิน
molecules.role: Secreted by osteoblasts; must be γ-carboxylated (by vitamin K) to bind hydroxyapatite — uncarboxylated osteocalcin (ucOC) is a biomarker of vitamin K insufficiency

molecules.name: Sclerostin (SOST)
molecules.label_th: สเคลโรสติน
molecules.role: Inhibits Wnt/β-catenin signaling in osteoblasts → brakes bone formation; suppressed by mechanical loading → loading permits bone building. Target of romosozumab (anti-sclerostin monoclonal)

molecules.name: RANKL (Receptor Activator of NF-κB Ligand)
molecules.label_th: แรงก์แอลไลแกนด์
molecules.role: Osteoblast/stromal-cell signal that activates osteoclast formation and survival → drives bone resorption; blocked by OPG (decoy) and by denosumab (monoclonal antibody)

molecules.name: Osteoprotegerin (OPG / TNFRSF11B)
molecules.label_th: ออสเตโอโปรเตเจอริน
molecules.role: Binds RANKL, preventing RANK activation → inhibits osteoclastogenesis; estrogen up-regulates OPG (why menopause accelerates bone loss)

molecules.name: Parathyroid Hormone (PTH)
molecules.label_th: พาราไทรอยด์ฮอร์โมน
molecules.role: Raises serum Ca by mobilizing bone Ca + increasing renal reabsorption + stimulating 1,25-(OH)₂D synthesis; chronic elevation (low vitamin D or low dietary Ca) drives net bone loss

molecules.name: Type II Collagen
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนชนิดที่สอง
molecules.role: Primary structural collagen of articular (hyaline) cartilage — ~90-95% of cartilage collagen; loss drives osteoarthritis

molecules.name: UC-II (Undenatured Type II Collagen)
molecules.label_th: UC-II คอลลาเจนชนิดที่ 2 ไม่เสียสภาพ
molecules.family: low-temperature processed type II collagen (40 mg dose)
molecules.role: Small oral dose is thought to act via oral tolerance mechanism at gut-associated lymphoid tissue (Peyer's patches) → dampens joint-directed T-cell response; Crolla 2016 trial showed superiority to glucosamine+chondroitin for knee OA

molecules.name: Glucosamine Sulfate
molecules.label_th: กลูโคซามีนซัลเฟต
molecules.role: Substrate for glycosaminoglycan/proteoglycan synthesis in cartilage; 1500 mg/day crystalline glucosamine sulfate (Rotta brand) has the strongest RCT evidence — ~50% reduction in total joint replacement risk at 5 y (Bruyère 2008, 2011)

molecules.name: Chondroitin Sulfate
molecules.label_th: คอนดรอยตินซัลเฟต
molecules.role: Major GAG in cartilage extracellular matrix; 800-1200 mg/day may modestly reduce pain and slow joint space narrowing (Cochrane 2015); frequently co-formulated with glucosamine

molecules.name: MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane)
molecules.label_th: เอ็มเอสเอ็ม
molecules.role: Sulfur donor for connective tissue (cysteine, GAGs); 3-6 g/day showed modest pain/WOMAC improvement vs placebo in small knee OA trials (Debbi 2011); mechanism partly anti-inflammatory (NF-κB dampening)

molecules.name: Hyaluronic Acid (Hyaluronan)
molecules.label_th: กรดไฮยาลูรอนิก
molecules.role: Primary lubricant in synovial fluid — provides viscoelasticity; intra-articular injections (Hyalgan, Synvisc) have clinical evidence for knee OA; oral HA 80-240 mg/day has weaker but positive signals

molecules.name: Hydrolyzed Collagen Peptides
molecules.label_th: คอลลาเจนเปปไทด์
molecules.role: Dietary peptides (e.g. Pro-Hyp, Hyp-Gly) reach circulation and may signal fibroblasts/chondrocytes; König 2018 showed 5 g/day specific collagen peptides improved BMD; Baar protocol uses 15 g + 50 mg vit C for connective tissue

molecules.name: Boron
molecules.role: Modulates steroid hormones and calcium/magnesium handling; low-dose (3 mg/day) observational links to BMD — evidence is tier C (weak)

organizations.name: NIH National Institute of Arthritis and Musculoskeletal and Skin Diseases
The Bone Clinic (Griffith University spin-off, Brisbane)

case_studies.name: LIFTMOR Trial (Watson, Weeks, Beck 2018)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 8-month supervised high-intensity resistance + impact training (HiRIT, 2×/wk) in 101 postmenopausal women with low BMD — +2.9% lumbar spine BMD, +0.3% femoral neck BMD vs control (which lost bone); only 1 minor adverse event; overturned the 'osteoporosis patients must avoid heavy lifting' dogma
case_studies.source: Watson SL, Weeks BK, Weis LJ, Harding AT, Horan SA, Beck BR. J Bone Miner Res. 2018;33(2):211-220.

case_studies.name: LIFTMOR-M Trial (Harding et al. 2020)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 8-month HiRIT in 34 older men with low BMD — increased lumbar spine BMD 3.7% and functional performance (timed stair climb, back extensor strength) vs control; replicated LIFTMOR in men
case_studies.source: Harding AT, Weeks BK, Lambert C, Watson SL, Weis LJ, Beck BR. Bone. 2020;136:115362.

case_studies.name: Knapen 3-Year MK-7 Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 244 postmenopausal women, 180 µg/day MK-7 for 3 years — decrease in uncarboxylated osteocalcin, slowed age-related BMD loss at lumbar spine and femoral neck, improved vertebral bone strength index vs placebo
case_studies.source: Knapen MH, Drummen NE, Smit E, Vermeer C, Theuwissen E. Osteoporos Int. 2013;24(9):2499-2507.

case_studies.name: DIPART pooled patient-level vitamin D + Ca meta-analysis (68,500 subjects)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Calcium + vitamin D (most commonly 800 IU + 1000 mg) reduced total fracture risk ~8% and hip fracture ~16% in adults ≥50 y; effect largely absent when vitamin D given alone

case_studies.name: GAIT — Glucosamine/chondroitin Arthritis Intervention Trial (Clegg et al. 2006)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: NIH-funded, 1583 knee OA patients, 24 weeks — glucosamine 1500 mg + chondroitin 1200 mg not superior to placebo overall (64.0% vs 60.1% responders, ns); but significant benefit in moderate-to-severe pain subgroup (79% vs 54% responders, p=0.002)
case_studies.source: Clegg DO et al. N Engl J Med. 2006;354(8):795-808.

case_studies.name: Crolla UC-II vs Glucosamine/Chondroitin 2016 Trial
case_studies.claim_to_fame: 191 knee OA patients, 6 months — 40 mg/day undenatured type II collagen reduced WOMAC score 39% vs 18% for 1500 mg glucosamine + 1200 mg chondroitin; both beat placebo, UC-II beat GC; reproduced 2009 Crowley pilot
case_studies.source: Lugo JP, Saiyed ZM, Lane NE. Nutr J. 2016;15:14.

case_studies.name: Hip Fracture 1-Year Mortality Cohort (Haentjens et al. 2010 meta-analysis)
case_studies.claim_to_fame: Meta-analysis of 22 studies — men ~22% and women ~18% excess 1-year mortality after hip fracture compared with age-matched controls; mortality gap persists for ~10 years
case_studies.source: Haentjens P et al. Ann Intern Med. 2010;152(6):380-390.
